dotenv:
# Keys for every way of launching Michi
export OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-openai
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-work # work account
QUOTED="quoted value" # note
SINGLE='single # kept'
MULTILINE="first\nsecond"
EMPTY=
CRLF=crlf-value
MICHI_DATA_DIR=/Users/test/michi-data
MICHI_CONFIG_DIR=/Users/test/michi-config
MICHI_KIRO_MAX_PROCESSES=7
MICHI_DEV_RENDERER=1
MICHI_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173
MICHI_REMOTE_TOKEN=from-file
MICHI_REMOTE_ACCESS=1
PORT=9999
